verdict.rationale: Ramp documents pre-spend policy controls: spend limits, blocked merchants and categories, and funds restricted by amount, interval, merchant category, merchant and country. Context-aware rules include per diem adjusted by trip location and duration, and policy status shown on travel options. Approval workflows route by spend amount, team role or category, and Ramp states that in-policy receipts are auto-approved while questionable or risky items are flagged or escalated to a human. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on configuring auto-approval rules and role-based limits (role appears mainly in notification and routing workflows), plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the auto-approve and exception flow.
